playerDelta: Until each gesture is learned, show a short directional cue for collection right-flick add and deck left-flick remove; hide that cue after the corresponding first successful action while keeping existing button/click fallbacks.
acceptance: right-flick add cue exists only while add gesture is unlearned
left-flick remove cue exists only while remove gesture is unlearned and a deck card exists
a successful corresponding swipe hides and remembers only that cue
failed/neutral gestures do not mark learned
existing swipe threshold, deck authority, add/remove fallback controls and save semantics are unchanged
rollback: Delete the branch or revert the two product/test commits; no main effect before merge.
